# Single-cell GEX: cell states and clonal programmes {#sec-sc-gex}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About this section
This section is present because the run supplied an annotated GEX object
(`--input_annotated_object`). It joins every receptor to its cell's transcriptional state and
asks which states carry the clonal expansion, which clones span several states, what the
expanded cells express, and where CoNGA and TCRi place them. It is rendered both inside the
Master Summary and as the standalone `SC_GEX_Report.html`.
:::

```{r}
#| label: gex-load
# Per-cell table: the T-cell integration export (cell state, clone, embedding), with the
# CoNGA, TCRi and consensus per-cell calls joined on cell_id.
gx <- T("tcell", "tcr_export_cells_with_embedding.tsv")
gx_by_id <- function(module, name, keep) {
  d <- T(module, name)
  if (!have(d) || !"cell_id" %in% names(d)) return(NULL)
  keep <- intersect(keep, names(d))
  if (!length(keep)) return(NULL)
  d <- d[, c("cell_id", keep), drop = FALSE]
  d$cell_id <- as.character(d$cell_id)
  d[!duplicated(d$cell_id), , drop = FALSE]
}
if (have(gx)) {
  gx$cell_id <- as.character(gx$cell_id)
  for (j in list(
    gx_by_id("conga", "conga_export_cells.tsv", c("conga_score", "conga_gex_cluster", "conga_tcr_cluster")),
    gx_by_id("tcri", "tcri_export_cells.tsv", c("tcri_score", "tcri_group", "tcri_predicted_phenotype")),
    gx_by_id("consensus", "consensus_export_cells.tsv", c("consensus_cluster")))) {
    if (!is.null(j)) gx <- left_join(gx[, setdiff(names(gx), setdiff(names(j), "cell_id")), drop = FALSE],
                                     j, by = "cell_id")
  }
  gx$annot   <- if ("annot" %in% names(gx)) as.character(gx$annot) else "Unannotated"
  gx$annot[is.na(gx$annot) | !nzchar(gx$annot)] <- "Unannotated"
  gx$has_tcr <- if ("has_tcr" %in% names(gx)) toupper(as.character(gx$has_tcr)) %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1") else !is.na(gx$clone_id)
  # The export's clone_size counts a clone across the whole cohort; expansion is judged
  # within a sample, so recount there.
  gx$clone_id[!gx$has_tcr] <- NA
  gx <- gx %>% group_by(sample, clone_id) %>%
    mutate(clone_size = ifelse(is.na(clone_id), NA_real_, as.numeric(n()))) %>% ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  gx$size_bin <- ifelse(!gx$has_tcr | is.na(gx$clone_size), "no TCR",
                 as.character(cut(gx$clone_size, c(0, 1, 2, 5, 20, Inf),
                                  labels = c("1 cell", "2 cells", "3-5 cells", "6-20 cells", ">20 cells"))))
  gx$expanded <- gx$has_tcr & !is.na(gx$clone_size) & gx$clone_size >= 2
  emb <- grep("^(umap|u|UMAP)_?[12]$", names(gx), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  gx_emb <- if (length(emb) >= 2) emb[1:2] else NULL
  gx_cond <- intersect(c("condition"), names(gx))
  gx_cond <- if (length(gx_cond) && n_distinct_real(gx[[gx_cond]]) >= 2) gx_cond else NULL
}
gx_tcr <- if (have(gx)) gx[gx$has_tcr, , drop = FALSE] else NULL
size_levels <- c("1 cell", "2 cells", "3-5 cells", "6-20 cells", ">20 cells", "no TCR")
size_cols   <- c("#a6a6a6", "#9ecae1", "#4292c6", "#08519c", "#de2d26", "#ececec")
state_cols  <- function(x) {
  lv <- sort(unique(as.character(x)))
  setNames(grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(pal, "#4d4d4d", "#b15928", "#6a3d9a", "#ff7f00"))(length(lv)), lv)
}

# Heatmap. m: numeric matrix with dimnames; hover text from fmt.
hmap <- function(m, title, zlab, colorscale = "Viridis", height = 520, zmid = NULL, fmt = "%{z:.2f}") {
  p <- plotly::plot_ly(x = colnames(m), y = rownames(m), z = m, type = "heatmap",
                       colorscale = colorscale, zmid = zmid,
                       colorbar = list(title = zlab),
                       hovertemplate = paste0("%{y} / %{x}<br>", zlab, ": ", fmt, "<extra></extra>"))
  pconf(plotly::layout(p, title = ttl(title), height = height,
                       margin = list(l = 140, b = 120, t = 60),
                       xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -45), yaxis = list(title = "")))
}

# Embedding scatter (WebGL), downsampled so the HTML stays light.
emb_plot <- function(d, colour, cols, title, max_points = 30000, hover = NULL) {
  set.seed(1)
  if (nrow(d) > max_points) d <- d[sample.int(nrow(d), max_points), , drop = FALSE]
  d$.x <- d[[gx_emb[1]]]; d$.y <- d[[gx_emb[2]]]; d$.c <- factor(d[[colour]], levels = names(cols))
  d$.h <- if (is.null(hover)) paste0(d$annot, "<br>", d$size_bin) else hover(d)
  d <- d[order(d$.c != "no TCR", d$clone_size, na.last = FALSE), , drop = FALSE]
  pconf(plotly::plot_ly(d, x = ~.x, y = ~.y, color = ~.c, colors = cols,
                        type = "scattergl", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 3),
                        text = ~.h, hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
        plotly::layout(title = ttl(title), height = 560, margin = list(t = 60),
                       xaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE),
                       yaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE),
                       legend = list(itemsizing = "constant")))
}
```

## Overview {#sec-sc-gex-overview}

```{r}
#| label: gex-overview
if (have(gx)) {
  ov_gex <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Cells in the GEX object", "Cells with a productive TCR", "TCR+ fraction",
               "Cells with paired alpha/beta", "Cells in expanded clones (>= 2 cells)",
               "Distinct clonotypes", "Cell states", "Samples",
               if (!is.null(gx_cond)) "Conditions"),
    Value = c(format(nrow(gx), big.mark = ","), format(sum(gx$has_tcr), big.mark = ","),
              percent(mean(gx$has_tcr), 0.1),
              if ("paired_tcr" %in% names(gx)) format(sum(toupper(gx$paired_tcr) %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1")), big.mark = ",") else NA,
              format(sum(gx$expanded), big.mark = ","),
              format(dplyr::n_distinct(gx_tcr$clone_id), big.mark = ","),
              as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(gx$annot)), as.character(n_distinct_real(gx$sample)),
              if (!is.null(gx_cond)) paste(sort(unique(gx[[gx_cond]])), collapse = ", ")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  save_table(ov_gex, "gex_overview.tsv")
  itable(ov_gex, pageSize = 10)
}
```

## The cell-state map {#sec-sc-gex-map}

```{r}
#| label: gex-umap-state
if (have(gx)) {
  if (is.null(gx_emb)) note("No embedding coordinates in the export; the cell-state map cannot be drawn.") else
    emb_plot(gx, "annot", state_cols(gx$annot), "Cells coloured by cell state")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-umap-size
if (have(gx) && !is.null(gx_emb)) {
  emb_plot(gx, "size_bin", setNames(size_cols, size_levels),
           "Cells coloured by the size of their clone in the sample",
           hover = function(d) paste0(d$annot, "<br>sample ", d$sample, "<br>clone size ", d$clone_size))
}
```

Expanded clones (blue to red) that gather in one region share a transcriptional programme;
clones scattered across the map span several states.

## Cell-state composition {#sec-sc-gex-composition}

```{r}
#| label: gex-composition-sample
if (have(gx)) {
  d <- gx %>% count(sample, annot, name = "n") %>% group_by(sample) %>%
    mutate(val = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    transmute(cat = sample, grp = annot, val,
              hover = paste0(sample, "<br>", annot, ": ", percent(val, 0.1), " (", n, " cells)"))
  save_table(d %>% select(sample = cat, annot = grp, fraction = val), "gex_state_composition_by_sample.tsv")
  sbar(d, "Cell-state composition per sample", "Fraction of cells",
       height = max(420, 26 * dplyr::n_distinct(d$cat) + 160))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-composition-condition
if (have(gx) && !is.null(gx_cond)) {
  # One value per sample, so samples with many cells do not dominate the comparison.
  d <- gx %>% count(sample, cond = .data[[gx_cond]], annot, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(sample) %>% mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::complete(tidyr::nesting(sample, cond), annot, fill = list(n = 0, frac = 0))
  save_table(d, "gex_state_fraction_by_sample_condition.tsv")
  pconf(plotly::plot_ly(d, x = ~annot, y = ~frac, color = ~cond, colors = pal, type = "box",
                        boxpoints = "all", jitter = 0.3, pointpos = 0,
                        text = ~paste0(sample, "<br>", annot, ": ", percent(frac, 0.1)),
                        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
        plotly::layout(boxmode = "group", title = ttl("Cell-state fractions per sample, by condition"),
                       height = 480, margin = list(t = 60, b = 110),
                       xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -30),
                       yaxis = list(title = "Fraction of the sample's cells", tickformat = ".0%"),
                       legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3)))
}
```

## Which cell states carry the clonal expansion {#sec-sc-gex-expansion}

```{r}
#| label: gex-expansion-state
if (have(gx_tcr)) {
  d <- gx_tcr %>% count(annot, size_bin, name = "n") %>% group_by(annot) %>%
    mutate(val = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(grp = factor(size_bin, levels = size_levels[1:5])) %>%
    transmute(cat = annot, grp, val,
              hover = paste0(annot, "<br>", size_bin, ": ", percent(val, 0.1), " (", n, " cells)"))
  save_table(d %>% select(annot = cat, size_bin = grp, fraction = val), "gex_clone_size_by_state.tsv")
  pconf(plotly::plot_ly(d, x = ~val, y = ~cat, color = ~grp, colors = size_cols[1:5],
                        type = "bar", orientation = "h",
                        text = ~hover, hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
        plotly::layout(barmode = "stack", title = ttl("Clone-size distribution of TCR+ cells per cell state"),
                       height = max(420, 30 * dplyr::n_distinct(d$cat) + 160), margin = list(l = 140, t = 60),
                       xaxis = list(title = "Fraction of TCR+ cells", tickformat = ".0%"),
                       yaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15)))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-expansion-condition
if (have(gx_tcr) && !is.null(gx_cond)) {
  d <- gx_tcr %>% group_by(sample, cond = .data[[gx_cond]], annot) %>%
    summarise(cells = n(), frac_expanded = mean(expanded), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(cells >= 10)
  save_table(d, "gex_expanded_fraction_by_sample_state.tsv")
  pconf(plotly::plot_ly(d, x = ~annot, y = ~frac_expanded, color = ~cond, colors = pal, type = "box",
                        boxpoints = "all", jitter = 0.3, pointpos = 0,
                        text = ~paste0(sample, "<br>", annot, ": ", percent(frac_expanded, 0.1),
                                       " of ", cells, " TCR+ cells expanded"), hoverinfo = "text") %>%
        plotly::layout(boxmode = "group", title = ttl("Expanded fraction per sample and cell state, by condition"),
                       height = 480, margin = list(t = 60, b = 110),
                       xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -30),
                       yaxis = list(title = "TCR+ cells in clones of >= 2", tickformat = ".0%"),
                       legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3)))
}
```

Each point is one sample's cells of that state (states with at least 10 TCR+ cells in the
sample), so the comparison is not driven by the samples with the most cells.

## Clones shared between cell states {#sec-sc-gex-sharing}

```{r}
#| label: gex-state-sharing
if (have(gx_tcr) && dplyr::n_distinct(gx_tcr$annot) > 1) {
  # A clone is counted per sample, so the same receptor in two patients is not a shared clone.
  occ <- gx_tcr %>% filter(expanded) %>% distinct(sample, clone_id, annot)
  if (!nrow(occ)) note("No expanded clones to compare across cell states.") else {
    st <- sort(unique(gx_tcr$annot))
    m <- matrix(0, length(st), length(st), dimnames = list(st, st))
    pairs <- occ %>% inner_join(occ, by = c("sample", "clone_id"), relationship = "many-to-many")
    tab <- pairs %>% count(annot.x, annot.y)
    m[cbind(tab$annot.x, tab$annot.y)] <- tab$n
    save_table(as.data.frame(m) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("annot"), "gex_state_clone_sharing.tsv")
    hmap(m, "Expanded clones found in both cell states", "Clones", colorscale = "Blues", fmt = "%{z}")
  }
}
```

The diagonal counts expanded clones with any cell in that state; off-diagonal cells count
clones with cells in *both* states, the signature of one clone giving rise to several
phenotypes.

```{r}
#| label: gex-plasticity
if (have(gx_tcr)) {
  d <- gx_tcr %>% filter(expanded) %>% group_by(sample, clone_id) %>%
    summarise(cells = n(), states = dplyr::n_distinct(annot),
              main_state = names(which.max(table(annot))),
              main_frac = max(table(annot)) / n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(cells))
  save_table(d, "gex_clone_state_plasticity.tsv")
  itable(head(d, 200), pageSize = 10)
}
```

Expanded clones with the number of cell states they occupy and the share of their cells in
the dominant state (top 200 by size).

## Gene expression of cell states and expanded cells {#sec-sc-gex-genes}

```{r}
#| label: gex-genes
gx_expr <- NULL
.rds <- as_str1(params$seurat_rds)
if (have(gx) && nzchar(.rds) && file.exists(.rds) && file.size(.rds) > 0) {
  gx_expr <- tryCatch({
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Seurat))
    seu <- readRDS(.rds)
    genes <- c("CD8A", "CD8B", "CD4", "SELL", "CCR7", "TCF7", "IL7R", "GZMK", "GZMA", "GZMB",
               "PRF1", "GNLY", "NKG7", "IFNG", "CX3CR1", "KLRG1", "ITGAE", "CD69", "ZNF683",
               "PDCD1", "HAVCR2", "LAG3", "TIGIT", "CTLA4", "TOX", "CXCL13", "ENTPD1",
               "KLRB1", "SLC4A10", "ZBTB16", "MKI67", "TOP2A", "FOXP3", "TRDC")
    genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(seu))
    cells <- intersect(gx$cell_id, colnames(seu))
    if (length(genes) < 2 || length(cells) < 50) NULL else {
      get_layer <- function(l) tryCatch(SeuratObject::LayerData(seu, layer = l),
                                        error = function(e) tryCatch(Seurat::GetAssayData(seu, slot = l),
                                                                     error = function(e) NULL))
      dat <- suppressWarnings(get_layer("data"))
      if (!is.null(dat) && all(dim(dat) > 0)) {
        mat <- dat[genes, cells, drop = FALSE]
      } else {
        # Downstream objects can carry counts only: LogNormalize the panel genes against
        # each cell's full library size, as Seurat's NormalizeData would.
        cnt <- get_layer("counts")[, cells, drop = FALSE]
        mat <- log1p(Matrix::t(Matrix::t(cnt[genes, , drop = FALSE]) / Matrix::colSums(cnt)) * 1e4)
      }
      rm(seu); invisible(gc())
      list(mat = as.matrix(mat), meta = gx[match(cells, gx$cell_id), , drop = FALSE])
    }
  }, error = function(e) { message("GEX expression unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
}
if (have(gx) && is.null(gx_expr)) note("The GEX object could not be read, or shares too few cells / marker genes with the export; expression panels are skipped.")
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-markers-state
if (!is.null(gx_expr)) {
  g <- gx_expr$meta$annot
  avg <- sapply(split(seq_along(g), g), function(i) Matrix::rowMeans(gx_expr$mat[, i, drop = FALSE]))
  z <- t(scale(t(avg)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  save_table(as.data.frame(avg) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"), "gex_marker_mean_by_state.tsv")
  hmap(t(z), "Canonical T-cell genes by cell state (row-scaled mean expression)", "z-score",
       colorscale = "RdBu", zmid = 0, height = max(420, 32 * ncol(z) + 200))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-markers-expanded
if (!is.null(gx_expr)) {
  md <- gx_expr$meta
  ok <- md$has_tcr
  st <- names(which(table(md$annot[ok & md$expanded]) >= 20 & table(md$annot[ok & !md$expanded]) >= 20))
  if (!length(st)) note("Too few expanded and non-expanded cells per state to compare expression.") else {
    lfc <- sapply(st, function(s) {
      e <- ok & md$annot == s
      Matrix::rowMeans(gx_expr$mat[, e & md$expanded, drop = FALSE]) -
        Matrix::rowMeans(gx_expr$mat[, e & !md$expanded, drop = FALSE])
    })
    save_table(as.data.frame(lfc) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"), "gex_expanded_vs_singleton_by_state.tsv")
    lim <- max(abs(lfc), na.rm = TRUE)
    hmap(t(lfc), "Expanded vs singleton cells within each state (difference in mean log-expression)",
         "Δ log-expr", colorscale = "RdBu", zmid = 0, height = max(420, 32 * length(st) + 200))
  }
}
```

Positive values (red) are genes higher in the cells of expanded clones than in singletons of
the *same* state, which separates expansion-associated programmes (for example cytotoxicity
or exhaustion) from differences between states. States need at least 20 cells of each kind.

## CoNGA {#sec-sc-gex-conga}

Graph-level correspondence between TCR similarity and transcriptional similarity. Clusters
scoring highly here contain cells that are neighbours in *both* spaces — the strongest
available evidence of antigen-driven clonal programmes.

```{r}
#| label: conga
if (!have(conga_roll) && !have(conga_clusters)) {
  note("CoNGA produced no output on this run.")
} else {
  if (have(conga_roll)) save_table(conga_roll, "master_conga_rollup.tsv")
  if (have(conga_clusters)) save_table(conga_clusters, "master_conga_clusters.tsv")
  itable(if (have(conga_roll)) conga_roll else conga_clusters, pageSize = 15)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-conga-state
if (have(gx_tcr) && "conga_score" %in% names(gx_tcr) && any(!is.na(gx_tcr$conga_score))) {
  # CoNGA score is a Bonferroni-adjusted p-value: < 1 marks a GEX/TCR neighbourhood hit.
  gx_tcr$conga_hit <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gx_tcr$conga_score)) < 1
  d <- gx_tcr %>% filter(!is.na(conga_hit)) %>% group_by(annot) %>%
    summarise(cells = n(), hits = sum(conga_hit), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(val = hits / cells)
  save_table(d, "gex_conga_hits_by_state.tsv")
  hbar(d %>% transmute(cat = annot, val, hover = paste0(annot, "<br>", hits, " / ", cells, " TCR+ cells (",
                                                        percent(val, 0.1), ")")),
       "CoNGA hits by cell state", "Fraction of TCR+ cells that are CoNGA hits",
       tickformat = ".0%", height = max(400, 30 * nrow(d) + 140))
} else if (have(gx_tcr)) note("No per-cell CoNGA scores were exported.")
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-conga-umap
if (have(gx) && !is.null(gx_emb) && "conga_score" %in% names(gx) && any(!is.na(gx$conga_score))) {
  sc <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gx$conga_score))
  gx$conga_lab <- ifelse(!is.na(sc) & sc < 1, "CoNGA hit", ifelse(gx$has_tcr, "TCR+, not a hit", "no TCR"))
  emb_plot(gx, "conga_lab", c("CoNGA hit" = "#de2d26", "TCR+, not a hit" = "#9ecae1", "no TCR" = "#ececec"),
           "CoNGA hits on the cell-state map",
           hover = function(d) paste0(d$annot, "<br>", d$conga_lab, "<br>clone size ", d$clone_size))
}
```

## TCRi {#sec-sc-gex-tcri}

TCRi scores how strongly a receptor sequence predicts the phenotype its cell adopts. High
scores mark clones whose fate appears written into the TCR.

```{r}
#| label: tcri
#| results: asis
if (!have(tcri_roll)) {
  note("TCRi produced no output on this run.")
} else {
  save_table(tcri_roll, "master_tcri_rollup.tsv")
  itable(tcri_roll, pageSize = 15)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gex-tcri-state
if (have(gx_tcr) && "tcri_score" %in% names(gx_tcr) && any(!is.na(gx_tcr$tcri_score))) {
  d <- gx_tcr %>% filter(!is.na(tcri_score)) %>%
    transmute(grp = annot, val = as.numeric(tcri_score),
              hover = paste0(annot, "<br>", sample, "<br>TCRi ", round(val, 3)))
  set.seed(1)
  if (nrow(d) > 20000) d <- d[sample.int(nrow(d), 20000), ]
  boxby(d, "TCRi score by cell state", "TCRi score", angle = -30)
} else if (have(gx_tcr)) note("No per-cell TCRi scores were exported.")
```

```{r}
#| label: tcri-clones
if (have(tcri_scores)) {
  save_table(tcri_scores, "master_tcri_high_clones.tsv")
  d  <- tcri_scores
  nc <- intersect(c("n_cells", "cells", "clone_size", "n"), names(d))
  cc <- intersect(c("clone_id", "CTaa", "clonotype"), names(d))
  if (!length(nc) || !length(cc)) {
    itable(d, pageSize = 10)
  } else {
    dd <- data.frame(cat = as.character(d[[cc[1]]]), val = as.numeric(d[[nc[1]]]))
    dd <- head(dd[order(-dd$val), , drop = FALSE], params$top_n_clusters)
    dd$hover <- paste0(dd$cat, "<br>", dd$val, " cells")
    hbar(dd, paste0("Top ", params$top_n_clusters, " high-TCRi clones"), "Cells", height = 560)
  }
}
```

## Consensus clusters by cell state {#sec-sc-gex-consensus}

```{r}
#| label: gex-consensus-state
if (have(gx_tcr) && "consensus_cluster" %in% names(gx_tcr)) {
  d <- gx_tcr %>% filter(!is.na(consensus_cluster), nzchar(as.character(consensus_cluster)),
                         !as.character(consensus_cluster) %in% c("NA", "none", "None"))
  top <- d %>% count(consensus_cluster, sort = TRUE) %>% head(params$top_n_clusters)
  if (!nrow(top)) note("No cells were assigned to a consensus cluster.") else {
    d <- d %>% filter(consensus_cluster %in% top$consensus_cluster) %>%
      count(consensus_cluster, annot, name = "n") %>% group_by(consensus_cluster) %>%
      mutate(val = n / sum(n), tot = sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
      transmute(cat = paste0(consensus_cluster, " (", tot, ")"), grp = annot, val,
                hover = paste0("cluster ", consensus_cluster, "<br>", annot, ": ", n, " cells"))
    save_table(d, "gex_consensus_state_composition.tsv")
    sbar(d, paste0("Cell-state make-up of the ", nrow(top), " largest consensus clusters"),
         "Fraction of cells", height = max(440, 26 * nrow(top) + 160))
  }
} else if (have(gx_tcr)) note("No per-cell consensus labels were exported.")
```

Consensus clusters group receptors predicted to share specificity. A cluster concentrated in
one state points to a specificity tied to that phenotype.
